mentions.name: Free-Visit FPS game editor
mentions.description: A 3D web FPS game editor that uses photos as the primary input to build realistic, immersive first-person shooter experiences (immersive-visit-games), paired with a lightweight FPS runtime that runs on any web device, including smartphones.
mentions.source_excerpt:
==> An FPS game editor, using photos as 1st imput.
==> It delivers a realistic FPS game. immersive-visit-game as we like to call it.
==> The FPS-Runtime is the lightest FPS existing today. It works on any web device, even Smartphones.
